chunks: And God sent down water from the sky, so He revived the earth after its death. Indeed, in that is a sign for a people who listen.
ai.seo_question: How does rain serve as a sign of resurrection in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nahl is frequently cited to draw a parallel between the physical revival of the earth by rain and the spiritual resurrection of humanity, emphasizing that just as barren land comes to life, so too will the graves yield to God's command. It underscores the concept of 'Qawm yasma'un' (a people who listen), suggesting that true understanding requires not just hearing the signs but internalizing the logic of resurrection through reflection on natural phenomena.
